highlights.title: Bangladesh vs. Ireland
highlights.subtitle: Great bowling by Hasan Murad, Curtis Campher is out!

incidents.commentary: No run.
SIX! Clean strike!
Flatter and shorter, on middle and leg, Young stabs it down on the leg side.
Floated up, on off, Young pushes it to cover.

OUT! LBW! Matthew Humphreys falls for a two-ball duck! Loopy ball, full and at the sticks. A bit too full for the sweep and the ball sneaks under the blade of Humphreys. It goes through to hit the front pad right in front of the stumps. Ahsan Raza gives it long thought before raising his finger. Humpreys reviews but the UltraEdge shows no bat involved and it is three reds on Ball Tracking with the ball crashing into the middle stump. Ireland are 278/9.
Speared in from around the wicket, attacking the front pad, Matthew Humphreys defends it watchfully.
Hasan goes wide on the crease and slants it into the right-hander, on a length, Barry McCarthy miscues the drive to mid on.
FOUR! Fine shot! Mahmud pitches it up again and offers a bit of width on off. Barry McCarthy transfers his weight onto the front foot and drives it through point for another boundary.

Rapped on the pads! There was a double sound and Bangladesh decide against the review. At 138.7 kph, attacking the stumps. Barry McCarthy looks to defend it with a straight bat but the ball nips back in to go past the inside edge. The ball clips the front pad first before making contact with the back pad. Going down leg!
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Fuller in length, outside off, Barry McCarthy presses on the front foot and plays it right under his eyes. Plays a punchy drive through point for a boundary.
Honing in on the off stump, on a good length, Barry guides it from the crease to gully.

Nearly knocked him over on the first ball! Mahmud steams in from over the wicket and hits the deck hard. On a back of a length, on top of off. Barry McCarthy hangs back to deal with it but the ball jags back in to go past the inside edge and sails over the off pole.

OUT! LBW! Tossed up on middle, angling in and straightens off. Jordan Neill tries to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge and gets hit on the pads. Bangladesh appeal and up goes the finger. Jordan Neill reviews but to no avail, as the Ball Tracking shows THREE REDS. Bangladesh end the day on a high. STUMPS!
Stays very low, fuller and on off, Jordan Neill blocks it quickly.
Good running! Too full and outside off, McCarthy drives it through cover-point. Nahid Rana runs back and slides to save a run.
Tossed up on middle, stays low. McCarthy hangs back to defend.
Looped up on a length and around off, McCarthy prods and defends it out.
Tossed up on middle, McCarthy leans and blocks.
This is full and around off, McCarthy plays with the angle to point for one.
Floated on middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
Straighter line on the pads, McCarthy keeps it out on the leg side.
Keeps it full and on off, defended out.
This is full and around off, McCarthy prods across and blocks.
Slower length delivery on middle and comes with the arm. McCarthy tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Very full and outside off, driven to point. Consecutive maidens.
Flat and on middle, Jordan Neill goes back and dead bats it.
Tossed up on a length and on off, Jordan Neill keeps it out on the deck.
Floated full and on middle, Jordan Neill defends.
This is full and outside off, punched to cover.
Fuller and on middle, blocked out.
Goes very full and on middle, played back to the bowler.
Very full and around off, McCarthy pushes it to the left of Mehidy Hasan Miraz.
Looped up, just outside off. McCarthy watchfully defends it out.
Floated full on off, McCarthy leans and blocks.
Tossed up on middle, Barry McCarthy pushes it back to the bowler.
Too full and on middle, played back to Hasan.
Tossed up on middle, played back to the bowler. 22 runs off the last 2 overs.
SIX! WOW! Flighted full and around off, in the slot for Jordan Neill who bends low and hammers it over long off for a six.
Tossed up on off, pushed to cover.
Flat and outside off, holds its line. Jordan Neill leaves it.
FOUR! Runs flying in the final few minutes of the day! Shorter and outside off, Jordan Neill cuts it late past third man for a boundary.
Floated full and around off, McCarthy pushes it to cover for a quick single.
Shorter and outside off, Jordan Neill dabs it to third man for a couple of runs. Sharp running.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Pitched up, outside off, Jordan Neill leans a bit and punches it past cover for a boundary. 250 up for Ireland.
Touch fuller and on middle, Jordan Neill solidly defends.
Length ball on off, punched to cover for a single.
Back of a length and outside off, McCarthy looks to pull but gets a bottom edge to the keeper.
FOUR! Streaky! Hard length delivery, outside off. McCarthy tries to punch but gets a thick outside edge, past widish slip and it races to third man for four.
A single to end the over as McCarthy carves it to cover.
Flat and outside off, McCarthy punches it to cover.
Tossed up, around off, McCarthy pushes it to point.
Barry McCarthy takes charge and swings across, plays off the inner half to the left of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Too full and on middle and off, blocked out.
Drops it full and on middle, McCarthy leans and blocks.
Serves it full and keeps it close to the off pole. Jordan Neill defends it well.
Length ball, outside off, punched to point.
Length and on middle, Jordan Neill watchfully blocks.
Bowls a bouncer around off, Jordan Neill mistimes his pull to square leg.
On a skiddy length and around off, Jordan Neill defends under his eyes and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length delivery on middle, Jordan Neill defends inside the line.
FOUR! Crunched away! Fuller delivery, outside off, stays low. McCarthy drives it past cover and it races to the fence.
Slower in the air, full and on middle, defended out.
Floats it full and around off, McCarthy leans and blocks it out.
Too full and outside off, McCarthy drives it past cover for a couple of runs.
Pushes it full and drifts in a bit, around off, Jordan Neill drives but manages a thick inside edge to fine leg for a single.
Too full and on middle, Jordan Neill blocks it out.
On a nagging length and shaping on the pads. McCarthy fails to flick. An appeal follows for LBW but it was going down.
Back of a length and on top of off, McCarthy thinks to play at it but withdraws his bat in the last moment.
A length delivery, around off, McCarthy plays it back to the bowler.
Well outside off, McCarthy shoulders arms to it.
Half-a-chance! Keeps it short, into the surface and it nips in. McCarthy slashes and gets a top edge, it lobs over Hasan Mahmud and to mid off.
Short in length, outside off, swinging away. McCarthy looks to cut but misses.
Quicker and fuller on middle, Jordan Neill prods and blocks.
Flat and on middle, Jordan Neill defends it out.
Too full and around off, Jordan Neill defends it to silly point.
WOW! Hasan Murad lands it on leg and makes it to spins away sharply, past Neill's outside edge and whisker away from off pole.
This one lands around off and spins away sharply, Jordan Neill leans to defend but misses.
Tossed up on middle, blocked out.
Flat and drifting around off, McCarthy solidly blocks it out.
This is full and around middle and off, McCarthy leans and blocks it out.
Length delivery, outside off, McCarthy punches it to cover.
Floated on middle, McCarthy gets behind the line and defends.
Spinning onto the middle pole, McCarthy nudges it to mid-wicket.
Too full and on middle, eased to long on for a single.
Flat and in the channel, around off, it lands and spins away, past the edge of McCarthy who tries to defend it.
Into the surface, holds a bit, around off, McCarthy knocks it to point.
An arm ball, around off, McCarthy plays it to cover.
Angles it full and on off, pushed to cover.
This is full and around off, McCarthy leans and defends it out.
Tossed up, outside off, McCarthy knocks it to cover.
Keeps bowling in the same channel! Floated on a length and on off, turning in. Jordan Neill rocks back to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but it was going down.
Tossed up around off, spinning in. Jordan Neill plays it back to Hasan.
Slower length delivery, outside off, Jordan Neill tries to dab it away but finds Shanto at first slip.
Too full and around off, Jordan Neill leans and blocks.
Slightly short and around off, Jordan Neill goes back to block.
Tossed up on middle, defended out.
Length ball on middle, McCarthy punches it to cover.
Much better line and length. Tossed up on a length and outside off, spins away. McCarthy is tempted to defend across but misses.
Flat and angling on middle, McCarthy plays it back to Murad.
Pushes it full and outside off, McCarthy looks to drive and gets a thick outside edge to third man for a couple.
Tossed up on middle, Jordan Neill leans to defend but gets a thick inside edge to fine leg. The batters take three runs.
Looped up full and on middle, Jordan Neill plays it back to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, McCarthy prods and blocks it out.
Shorter and angling on off, McCarthy defends.
Tossed up, outside off, Jordan Neill plays it to point for a single.
Flat and turning in on middle, played back to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, defended out.
FOUR! Cut away! Shorter and outside off, Jordan Neill cuts it past point for a boundary. Welcome boundary. Ireland still believe they can rescue themselves from hereon.
Flat and angling on middle, McCarthy rocks back and blocks.
Looped up on middle, McCarthy gets forward and defends in front of the pads.
Floated around off, Jordan Neill knocks it to cover for a single.
Flat and outside off, Jordan Neill leans and blocks it out.
Tossed up, around off, Jordan Neill drops it to point.
Flighted well outside off, Jordan Neill leaves it alone.
Tossed up on off, Barry McCarthy leans and defends it out.

OUT! STUMPED! Mehidy Hasan Miraz strikes and the hosts have clawed their way into the game. Quicker, outside off, with a hint of turn. Andy McBrine moves forward and looks to flick it but misses. Litton Das behind the sticks collects the ball and makes no mistake.
Full again, on off, Andy McBrine digs it back to the bowler.
Much fuller, on off, Andy McBrine lunges and blocks it back to the bowler.

OUT! STUMPED! Quicker, on off, and it turns away. Lorcan Tucker lunges and looks to block it but misses. Litton Das, behind the sticks, collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. The umpire checks and confirms that Lorcan Tucker was short of his crease. An important wicket for Bangladesh.
Quicker, on middle, Lorcan Tucker pushes it to mid off.

SIX! That's a massive hit! A half tracker that sits up to be hit, Lorcan Tucker winds up and clatters it all the way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Too full, on middle, Andy McBrine pushes it to mid off.

OUT! LBW! Hasan strikes early. The skipper departs. Much fuller, on off, and it shapes in. Andy Balbirnie hangs back and looks to drive it but misses and the ball hits his pads. A loud appeal and the finger goes up straightaway. Andy Balbirnie has a chat with his partner and decides to send it upstairs. Ultra Edge shows a spike but there was a clear gap so there was clearly no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that the impact was umpires call and the onfield decision will stand.
